sources.annualQuery: select date_extract_y(date_reported) as year, sna_neighborhood, cpd_neighborhood, community_council_neighborhood, ucr_group, count(*) as count where date_reported between '2011-01-01T00:00:00' and '2024-06-02T23:59:59' group by year, sna_neighborhood, cpd_neighborhood, community_council_neighborhood, ucr_group order by year, sna_neighborhood limit 50000

select date_extract_y(datereported) as year, sna_neighborhood, stars_category, type, count(*) as count where datereported between '2024-06-03T00:00:00' and '2025-12-31T23:59:59' group by year, sna_neighborhood, stars_category, type order by year, sna_neighborhood limit 50000
